page.overview:
Who is Nestor Amset?

Sir Nestor Amset was a wizard who became a ghost and joined the Headless Hunt.

In life, Sir Nestor Amset was a minor member in a plot to overthrow the government of his county and take power, choosing the wrong side in the dispute. After being executed by beheading, he returned as a ghost. Some time after becoming a ghost, Sir Nestor was invited to join the Headless Hunt with other ghosts who died by decapitation. Within the Hunt, he was considered the bottom of the social hierarchy.

Sir Nestor Amset possibly participated in the Battle of Hogwarts on 2 May 1998 with other members of the Headless Hunt.
